title: A visible grade form is licensed only in established composition slots
summary: GDT419 observes populated and absent grade cells across recurrent compositional families. A speculative hypothesis is that E/EE/EEE is an operator allowed only by a family-specific grade slot, not a freely insertable modifier.

design.unit: complete compositional family with a visible E/EE/EEE-bearing cell and a matched ungraded cell
design.contrast: grade form is legal only in a prelicensed slot versus grade is a freely attachable modifier
design.prediction: Across held families, visible grade changes should occur only where the family already has a grade slot; ungraded sibling frames should retain their argument/action roles without accepting arbitrary E/EE/EEE insertion.
design.countermodel: The apparent empty cells may reflect sparse sampling, and grade forms may be optional modifiers whose absence has no structural meaning.
design.falsifier: A held family admits an independently comparable E/EE/EEE insertion into an otherwise ungraded anchor with no slot change, or a licensed family repeatedly rejects its grade alternation.
design.principal_risk: The German role labels are model-derived; only form distribution is source-independent.
design.related: Near GDT419 and IDEA000048, but the raw discriminator is a prelicensed composition slot and an insertion counterexample, not absolute versus relative degree.

source_evidence.quote:
## Die wichtigste neue Regel

Grad ist **nicht frei einschiebbar**. Alle fünf getesteten Gradlöschungen sind
belegt, sechs von zehn Gradwechseln sind belegt, aber keine der sechs freien
Gradeinfügungen in bislang ungradierte Anker kommt vor. Der bessere
Werkstattmechanismus lautet daher:

> Eine bereits lizenzierte Gradschublade kann E, EE, EEE oder keinen Grad
> tragen; der Schreiber darf die Schublade nicht beliebig hinter jedem
> Handlungskopf erfinden.

Das ist wichtig für neue Seiten: ein sichtbares E/EE/EEE wird nur dann als Grad
gelesen, wenn die umgebende Rezeptfamilie die Gradstelle schon lizenziert.
